abilities.name: Phase
abilities.text: The active Unit resolves the PLACE (3) effect.

abilities.name: Warp Conduit
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield more than 10″ away from any Enemy model. At the End of the Round, you may Deploy one Ground unit from Reserves in base-to-base Contact with this Faction Indicator.
